plugin.name: Tony Hawk Pro Skater 4 Widescreen Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Render width in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Render height in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.FixHUD.description: Center and scale the HUD and menu elements for widescreen. Restart required.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier on top of widescreen correction. 1.0 preserves the intended framing. Applies to normal local-player follow cameras, excluding fixed, animated and script-overridden views.
MAIN.RandomSongOrderFix.description: Randomize song selection instead of repeating the original order. Restart required.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. The selection takes effect at startup. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the last window mode while retaining the render resolution.
SkipIntro.description: Skip publisher, studio and technology logo movies. Story introductions and other movies remain available. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Fullscreen videos: 0 preserves the original aspect with black bars; 1 fills the screen without stretching and crops overflow; 2 stretches to the screen. Applies live. Menu preview videos keep their own layout.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Single-player score, special, stance and minigame timer stay left; goal and cash information stay right. Auto uses the screen width. A W:H ratio or decimal limits these groups to a centered box, clamped to 4:3–32:9. Centered indicators, projected world labels and split-screen placement are unchanged.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus. Turning this off releases it immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changed startup settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
FPSLimit.description: Limits presentation to the selected frame rate; 0 disables the limiter. 60 FPS is recommended; higher rates can break gameplay. Restart required.
